Compare itemized Kayle/Solar boards and itemized Aphelios/Lunar boards as separate families, defined without using Eclipse status to select them. Within each family, compare active Eclipse with its complement in the same family. Keep dual-itemized boards separate from the two single-carry families, and show the Solar members' upgrade levels for each result.

Use the available Set 18 standard-ranked final-board data.

expected_output.reference: Evidence-relative package comparison. Unitemized appearances are not carry evidence, and lack of a reportable result is not a zero-performance result.
requirements: Operationalize Mama Beak carry investment with named offensive completed items on Mama Beak, requiring at least two and showing three-item sensitivity separately; distinguish these boards from unitemized Mama Beak appearances.
Report the qualifying Mama Beak loadouts and sample counts, with her star levels kept distinct where data permits.
Compare joint three-Summoner/three-Riftbeast support with higher-Riftbeast support, preserving higher-Riftbeast boards that still have Summoner as an explicit overlapping hybrid group.

For reportable package cells, give counts and mean placement, top-four rate, and win rate; describe matching or stratification by level, stars, frontline, and secondary-carry investment only to the degree the evidence supports.

State that a complete boardwide item budget, Alpha Mark ownership, and a generic offensive combat role are not directly certified by these tools; do not interpret the observed association as causation or compare named item variants as the requested question.

Support any exact same-holder multi-item claim with occurrence-bound loadout evidence or a one-copy guard across all stars plus separate star and item-count conditions; separate holder predicates can otherwise match items on different same-name copies.

items.input:
When Mama Beak is actually the carry, do three-Summoner boards with a small Riftbeast package outperform the vertical Riftbeast versions?

Treat Mama Beak as the carry only when the board records at least two explicitly named offensive completed items on her; report three-item builds separately and retain her exact star level. Compare the three-Summoner/three-Riftbeast package with higher-Riftbeast support, while keeping boards that also retain Summoner in the higher-Riftbeast group visible as hybrids. This is a support-package comparison, not a comparison of particular Riftbeast item variants.

Use the available Set 18 standard-ranked final-board data.

expected_output.reference: Evidence-relative support-package comparison; either observed package may lead. Suppressed or unavailable groups are unknown, not zero.
requirements: Establish that Azir and Zyra are each itemized with at least two named offensive completed items in the analyzed population; show their qualifying item builds and keep their star levels distinct.

Identify supporting units and recorded trait contributions for the Blackthorn/Brawler and Juggernaut-frontline/extra-Executioner packages, checking joint support rather than inferring it from separate trait marginals.
Retain and describe boards where the packages overlap as hybrids; do not force Blackthorn, Juggernaut, or Executioner traits into exclusive labels.

Report package recurrence or sample counts, overlap, mean placement, top-four rate, and win rate, and describe like-for-like levels and named unit/star/item investment only where the data supports it.

Include observed Summoner support and extra carry or tank items when available, and state that the association does not establish Blackthorn sacrifice identity, summon contribution, damage share, tanking, or a causal package benefit.

Support any exact same-holder multi-item claim with occurrence-bound loadout evidence or a one-copy guard across all stars plus separate star and item-count conditions; separate holder predicates can otherwise match items on different same-name copies.

items.input:
On boards carrying Azir and Zyra together, is the Blackthorn/Brawler package worth more than keeping Juggernaut frontline and extra Executioner support?

Require both Azir and Zyra to have at least two explicitly named offensive completed items, and analyze the observed carry star-level combinations separately. Compare the Blackthorn/Brawler support package with the Juggernaut-frontline/extra-Executioner package. Keep boards containing parts of both packages visible as hybrids, and report Summoner support and additional carry or tank item investment where observable.

Use the available Set 18 standard-ranked final-board data.
